caveats: Worker isolation deviation: sun-estimate-worker agents had no file tools in this harness, so scoring ran on general-purpose sub-agents restricted by prompt to read only the rubric, worker contract and their own batch file and to write one output file; no network or source access.
Issue bodies are self-authored backlog items (LAB-5); sub-issues often reference the parent issue for sources ('như issue cha'), lowering confidence for some rows.
Existing-estimate check unavailable (no KPI Insight source); all open items assessed.
